newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Mark,dlr basket deals lead Hungary FX futures mkt.
newsitem.headline: Mark,dlr basket deals lead Hungary FX futures mkt.

text.p: Basket deals in marks and dollars set the pattern for Tuesday trading on Budapest's currency futures market, dealers said.

Selling of September and March marks and dollars in the 70-30 proportion the two units take up in the basket against which the forint floats accounted for half of all forex futures trade on the Budapest Commodity Exchange and over 60 percent of turnover on the Budapest Stock Exchange.
BCE turnover totalled a moderate 4.85 billion forints while trade on the much smaller BSE forex futures market stood at 105 million forints for the day.

Basket deals are seen as a means of hedging against future large fluctuations of the dollar/mark and are based on the central bank's currency basket against which the forint is devalued by 1.1 percet per month.
The basket is made up 70 percent of the mark and 30 percent of the dollar.
Within the basket deals, mark falls were counterbalanced by dollar rises.
The mark fell 0.26 to 112.00 forints for September and by 0.3 to 119.8 forints for March. The dollar rose 0.6 to 191.9 for September and by the same amount to 202.1 for March.
The June dollar also saw significant turnover and rose one forint to 186.1.
The BSE also saw a basket deal for September, with the September mark falling 0.30 to 112.2 and the September dollar 1.28 to 192.28.
The central bank quoted the two currencies in its midday fix at 104.67 forints to the mark, down 0.12, and 181.15 to the dollar, up 0.64.
